Questions

Frequently Asked

Is this official VA documentation?

No. This is supplemental evidence you create yourself to support your claim. The VA allows and considers personal statements and logs as evidence. Our templates are designed to capture the exact criteria raters evaluate.

Will this guarantee a higher rating?

Nothing can guarantee a specific rating—that depends on your actual condition and medical evidence. What these templates do is ensure you're documenting your symptoms in the format and language that raters are trained to evaluate, so nothing gets lost in translation.

I already have my C&P exam scheduled. Is it too late?

Ideally, you'd have 30 days of documentation. But even 1-2 weeks of detailed logging is better than nothing. Start today. You can also continue logging and submit additional evidence after your exam if your claim is still pending.

Do I need to use a VSO or attorney?

These templates are designed for veterans who want to strengthen their own claims. They work alongside VSO assistance or on their own. We always recommend consulting with an accredited VSO for complex claims.

What format are the templates?

PDF format. You can print them directly, fill them out digitally on a tablet, or use the format as a guide for your own documentation. Print as many copies as you need.

Are you affiliated with the VA?

No. YourWonClaim is a veteran-owned business. We are not affiliated with, endorsed by, or connected to the Department of Veterans Affairs. We're veterans who've navigated the claims process and want to help others avoid the frustration we experienced.

Ready to Document Your Claim the Right Way?
